title: Apps Backup and Restore
summary: Backup your installed apps and reinstall it easily
description:
Now save data charges and time by backup and restore Apps .
Apps Backup and Restore is used to backup your installed apps to your internal/SD card and restore backup-ed apps.
Note: This app don't backup data related to apps.

Features of the App:

→ Backup apps to Internal/SD card
→ Reinstall apps from Internal/SD card
→ Auto backup app on new app install
→ Backup system apps
→ Uninstall installed app
→ Launch installed app
→ share apk with your friends easily
→ Share app link
→ More options on long click on app list


More features will be added to the app as per your suggestions and feedback.
